name: The Whelk
notes: From the food, drinks and dessert menus on the restaurant's own website (the site's current menu). Wines with two or three prices are split into glass, bottle and (for the Valentines rosé) magnum entries; a single wine price is per bottle. The website also shows Friday-Saturday lunch hours, but its lunch and brunch menus are older PDFs, so they are not included. Hours, phone and address from the website.
